query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE ensure_members SET tenant_id = $2, email = $3 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO ensure_member_events (id, recorded_at, sequence, event_type, event) SELECT updated.id, COALESCE($4, NOW()), ROW_NUMBER() OVER () + $5, unnested.event_type, unnested.event FROM updated CROSS JOIN UNNEST($6::TEXT[], $7::JSONB[]) AS unnested(event_type, event) RETURNING recorded_at
